query: MATCH (a:CloudNode)-[e:CloudEdge]->(b:CloudNode) WHERE a.layer <> 'semctl' AND b.layer <> 'semctl' RETURN a.node_id,b.node_id,e.edge_type,e.props,e.layer,e.snapshot_ts ORDER BY a.node_id,b.node_id,e.edge_type,e.props,e.layer,e.snapshot_ts
source_identity_rule: CloudEdge loader identity is source_id + target_id + edge_type + props; the B4 topology projection omits properties but preserves one graph edge per source row.
consumer_rule: Preserve row multiplicity as parallel directed edges. Never convert the edge rows to a set and never silently deduplicate projected tuples.
